verdict.rationale: CHKit lets users and agents describe, validate, test, and deploy schema and pipelines as code in CI, with a reviewable diff. That covers versioning and review of pipeline automations. Rollback of those automations is not documented: point-in-time recovery rolls back data, not pipeline or automation definitions, so it is an adjacent capability and earns no credit. Missing for 10: documented rollback of deployed pipelines/automations, detail on version history for alert rules and batch jobs, independent or hands-on corroboration of CHKit's workflow.
